name: 江湖风云3
english_description: In-game titled "Sunset Reappears: Storm Rising II," a sequel/expansion of this project's jhfy2 (7,977 of jhfy2's 9,332 files overlap by path, with jhfy3 substantially expanding on that base), a Jin Yong-themed mudlib. Despite the heavy file-path overlap with jhfy2, this archive's "Peak of the World" cliff-jump scene is actually byte-identical not to jhfy2's "Tianya" family version but to xajh4gkb (Xiao'ao Jianghu 4, Public Edition, which also carries the "Sunset Reappears" brand) and xyzx (one of the original "Sunset Reappears" releases) — showing that "Sunset Reappears" is a separate code lineage from "Tianya," and that this archive builds on jhfy2's map while swapping in "Sunset Reappears" core system files.
